experiment: Transport-free native identity proxy bridge core conformance
head: a298faa3417e41c79c4a34ebb8e05aefe1e1ad25
interpretation: Both actual short-gate platforms compiled and executed the fixed synthetic conformance binary once: installed x64 MSVC on Windows and g++ on Linux. Each passed 63 pure/mock tests and strict validation of all 428 case result rows. Held-process exit, bounded-reader termination, handles closed and cleanup are confirmed in both closed receipts. The verifier requires exit zero, one bounded LF or CRLF JSON line and exact rows; the receipt does not export raw output or individual syscall logs.

The native core is transport-free C++17 with separate frontend and relay local reducers, explicit 48-byte little-endian RPB1 frames, bounded HTTP matching/canonical construction and caller-supplied synthetic monotonic time. The test executable accepts no arguments or input corpus and invokes no sockets, processes, profiles, security, real clock, environment or file-input APIs. Its only explicit I/O is bounded stdout; ordinary CRT startup behavior is not claimed absent.

The driver compares every valid native pending-write prefix with compiled expected bytes before acknowledging progress. This prevents a same-length encoder or HTTP constructor error from passing merely because final state snapshots agree. The fixed corpus includes split points, allowed exact-limit HTTP variants, malformed/smuggling and over-limit negatives, replay, EOF, deadline, close uncertainty and local-causality counterexamples.

The unchanged Python model is a joint-trace oracle only at transport-realizable FIFO barriers, not an omniscient condition imposed on a real endpoint. Independent goldens exercise local acceptance without hidden remote-send or remote-close knowledge. READY and DONE are protocol assertions, not identity, origin delivery or OS cleanup proof. Confirmed mock closes and durable model observations remain distinct.

The new explicit execution helper binds the manifest, generated header, source hashes and executable before and after execution. It uses a 10-second work deadline, at most 65537 captured bytes to detect the 65536-byte bound, and one separate at-most-one-second cleanup allowance. Uncertain spawn, reader, exit or close facts deny conformance; no retries are performed. Synchronous file/process APIs are not individually hard-cancellable.

Windows path and file-descriptor metadata are checked for stability within their respective semantics, retaining ctime in each bracket; dev/inode/size/mtime bind the path to the opened file. A forced Windows-style ctime mismatch fixture exercises the real bounded reader and manifest verifier. This changes only the new pure-runner helper, not any existing production provenance code.

The preexisting identity sidecar compiled its actor and passed 381 overlapping pure tests. All token, pipe, restricted and paired runtime steps were skipped; its existing public build artifact path is separate from this dedicated gate, which uploads no artifacts. The local full required regression passed 1008 tests; this is scoped evidence, not an assertion about the entire repository.

The genuine Stage0b 32-byte anonymous-pipe prerequisite remains independently archived at 88f1b4e26171c25c255ba97be6eb55c0b30dcfb2. This new model result does not establish a native 48-byte pipe wrapper, identity-bound proxy-positive route, proxy-death fail-closed behavior, or product isolation. No automatic VM or network experiment follows.
